The race among efficient models built for real work has a new leader: Muse Ember by @AIatMeta.

Ember (Max) leads on every dimension against GPT-6 Luna (Max) from @OpenAI and Claude Haiku 5.5 (High) by @AnthropicAI:

- Speed: 27s per task vs 5.8 min and 1.9 min
- Performance: +2.3% Net Improvement (Agent Arena score) vs +1.4% and +0.4%
- Cost: 1.9¢ per task vs 7.0¢ and 6.9¢

That’s ~13x faster than Luna and less than a third of the cost of either. Below find more analysis on Ember’s steerability score across Work, and a look at what real-world tasks users are shipping with Muse Ember in the Agent Arena.
